crossRefs.note: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
translations.bsb: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘This will be My sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
translations.asv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be a holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
